title: Synergy of Large Model and Small Model for Port Safety Management
summary: ZTE reports that its Nebula vision system at Taicang Port eliminated 92% of false fire alarms and detected unsafe behavior; no source reports injuries prevented.
source_collection: ITU AI for Good: Innovate for Impact (2025)
account: ZTE reports that it deployed its Nebula vision system at Taicang Port. An edge detector flags possible fire or smoke, and a larger cloud vision model checks the context to reject false positives. ZTE reports that the system eliminated 92% of false fire alarms and detected unsafe behavior. ZTE reports that it tested the system at Taicang Port on 65 videos, 30 with smoke and 35 without. It states that accuracy exceeded 90% and that the false alarm rate stayed below 5%. No independent source verifies these gains. Prevented injuries remain unestablished.
purpose: Improve port risk detection while reducing false alarms.
system: ZTE Nebula hybrid port-safety vision system

ratings.reason: The deployed port system reportedly eliminated 92% of false fire positives and identified unsafe activity. Prevented harm remains unestablished.
Safer working conditions are intended. Injury and exposure outcomes remain unreported.

evidence.citation: ZTE Corporation, Use Case 9 (Manufacturing) in International Telecommunication Union, AI for Good: Innovate for Impact, Report 2025. Project-submitted account by the developer, current as of June 2025. It reports 65 on-site test videos and gives no deployment date, and ITU provides no independent outcome evaluation.

The 92% false-alarm reduction requires baseline counts, test definitions, and uncertainty across the 65 tests. Rejecting false alerts must also be assessed against missed real fires and response delays. Unsafe-behavior detection is not proof of prevented injuries.
